# Sam's News — tech — 2026-10-01

## Tech

### <span class="imp imp-mid" title="Importance 5/10" aria-label="Importance 5 of 10">5</span> President of the United States and Tech Leaders Sign Voluntary AI Accord
The president of the United States convened top tech executives at the White House on September 29, 2026, where they signed "The White House Accord on Superintelligence," a voluntary self-regulation agreement committing companies to implement internal controls, audits, and independent board-level oversight for AI systems. The accord represents the administration's preference for industry self-regulation over government mandates.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Signatories include CEOs from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta, xAI, and Nvidia</li>
<li>Agreement requires each company to implement internal controls, audits, and independent board-level oversight</li>
<li>Apple was the sole major tech company absent from the White House lunch on September 29</li>
<li>The accord is described as voluntary but the president called it &#x27;morally binding&#x27;</li>
</ul>
